limitations: Training first/last batches differ in t/tasks. Compare paired arms on the same hashes; do not infer generation quality from lower training loss.
A/B seam values are diagnostics and weighted seam loss is zero.
Representative parameter update norms cover 256 registered coordinates; e_boundary boundary_update_norm is full vector.
CUDA peaks are cumulative training allocated/reserved; neither is standalone process VRAM and they must not be added.
Boundary vector norm alone does not measure hidden-state effect or causal efficacy; no extra model sensitivity probes were performed.
Weighted auxiliary/FM loss ratio is not the calibration output-gradient ratio or a network parameter-gradient ratio.
